title: Custom Bakehouse
description: About Custom Bakehouse Custom Bakehouse specializes in providing quick and convenient baking mixes that allow customers to enjoy homemade baked goods with ease. Their product range includes various scone mixes and other baking essentials designed for both home cooks and retail stores. Custom Bakehouse was the target of a cyberattack. As a result of the attack, more than 100 GB of documents were stolen. Including confidential information
